notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 region and dimension lifecycle surface. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador API plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, dimensional FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and any logical-time implementation. It verifies pre-connect and pre-join boundaries, dimension metadata and bounds, region creation, range modification and commit, region-qualified service boundaries, handle-set lookup, range validation, and deletion without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador region creation, dimension lookup, range-bound, commit, deletion, and region-qualified object/attribute/interaction services
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador region and dimension declarations
